records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Net sales were $1,097.2 million, an increase of 7.1%

records.title: 10-K
records.text: We ended 2020 with a strong backlog of orders, which has grown throughout 2021 across our global organization as well as in both the Infrastructure Solutions and Materials Solutions segments.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: While our businesses have generally remained operational throughout the pandemic, with temporary closures in the United Kingdom and South Africa early in the pandemic, our business has been significantly affected by the contributory effects of the pandemic such as decreased demand for our products in 2020, material price increases, increased lead times from production materials, supplies and parts and labor shortages.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: While oil prices have increased throughout 2021, its price volatility makes it difficult to predict the costs of oil-based products used in road construction such as liquid asphalt and gasoline.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Income from operations decreased $20.9 million to $22.1 million
